title: Backend Developer @ UCLA Campus Events Commission
achievements: Reduced new developer onboarding overhead by ~75% (4 weeks to 1 week) by orchestrating development environment with Docker & Kubernetes.
Cut query load on the main database by 30% and boosted API response latency by 20% by integrating Redis caching.
Fast-tracked deliverable timeline by 3 weeks as Backend Lead by facilitating Scrum sprints on Jira.

details.headline: From Fragile Monolith to Modern Microservices
details.problem: The developer onboarding process was crippled by a fragile legacy architecture. The tangled monolith, built on an outdated Keystone.js version, was incompatible with modern Node.js, bringing local development to a halt and taking up to four weeks to onboard a single developer.
details.solution: I architected and led a complete overhaul by decoupling the monolith into a Keystone 6 Headless CMS and a modern Next.js frontend. I then containerized the entire stack using Docker and Docker Compose, creating a fully isolated, reproducible environment condensed into a single `docker-compose up` command.

impact.text: Reduction in new developer onboarding time (4 weeks to 1)
Reduction in database query load via Redis caching

techHighlight.title: Code Spotlight: docker-compose.yml
techHighlight.code:
version: '3'
services:
  backend:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    # ... (environment variables and volumes)
    command: yarn dev

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    depends_on:
      - backend
    # ... (environment variables and volumes)
    command: yarn dev

volumes:
  backend_data: # Persists the database
  # ... (node_modules volumes for caching)

points.title: depends_on
points.description: Ensures the backend is healthy before the frontend starts, preventing race conditions.

points.title: Named Volumes
points.description: Persists critical data (SQLite DB) and cached dependencies, separating the container's lifecycle from its data.

points.title: Docker Networking
points.description: Services communicate using service names (e.g., 'backend') as hostnames, demonstrating an understanding of Docker's internal DNS.

points.title: Environment Variables
points.description: Decouples configuration from code, following the 12-Factor App methodology for portability and security.
